consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at Manor Downs on September 13, 1983, was inspired and featured standout moments, particularly in the Scarlet>Fire transition. Many reviewers praised the energy of the band and the overall vibe of the show, despite some concerns about the recording quality.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 22 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and highlighted specific songs, there were also mentions of recording quality issues and mixed feelings about the overall show, leading to a slightly positive adjustment.
